capabilities: Draw flowcharts, mind maps, sequence diagrams, tables and sticky notes on whiteboards
Place vault notes, pictures, other boards and web links as live cards on the board
Convert flowcharts and diagrams between Mermaid text and board objects
Export boards to PNG, SVG, a Markdown note or an Obsidian canvas
Present board sections as slides and keep per-board version history
extras: Marked as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Version history lives in a hidden .boardline folder that Obsidian Sync does not sync, so it stays on the device where it was made. Beta versions installable via BRAT; requires Obsidian 1.8.7 or later.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in whiteboard with diagram-specific shapes, self-routing connectors, mind-map and sequence-diagram tools, or boards stored as plain vault files.

relations.evidence: Export to PNG, SVG, a Markdown note or an Obsidian canvas
paste a flowchart, sequence diagram or mind map to turn it into board objects

summary: Whiteboard plugin that stores each board as a .board file in the vault, for flowcharts, mind maps, sequence diagrams, tables, sticky notes and vault notes on the board.
